law: An alias supplies only which repository name to search under. The reconciler still computes the state from what that search finds, so an alias can never promote a row on its own, and an alias that stops resolving fails the compile rather than silently reverting the row to MISSING. Every entry below was checked against the tree: the named module exists and implements the section's mechanism, not merely a similar phrase.

aliasDeclarations.reason: The directive's UNKNOWN-UNKNOWN MACHINE is UberBond's Unknown-Unknown Mining organ, which is the canonical name in the total North Star and has its own module and suite.
Founder-minute accounting and prioritisation live in founder-minute-priority. The directive names the discipline; the repository names the module after what it ranks.
Zero-Day Frontier Radar is the canonical Perpetual Frontier organ that watches for capability-changing technology signals.
The Personal Civilization canon calls this the Life Knowledge Graph; it connects people, projects, decisions, goals and events with provenance on every edge.
Generation-over-generation improvement and retention measurement lives here. It is where velocity is computed, and no separate velocity module exists.
Founder-absence duration classes and what continues without the founder are modelled by the founder-absence readiness organ and its doctor.

The directive asks for continuous deficit measurement across seventeen named capability dimensions, producing ranked bottlenecks. That is the OMEGA spine: nullstar-omega-generation carries the seventeen-dimension vector and nullstar-omega-bottleneck ranks by downstream unlocks per unit cost from a declared dependency graph. Checked against the tree: the ranking is computed from measured evidence, not asserted, and G0 through G4 each produced one.

The directive's FOUNDER COCKPIT is the founder command center. Independently corroborated by the OMEGA denominator, whose N24 dimension is named FOUNDER_COCKPIT and already resolves to this module. The alias supplies the name only; whether the ten named interface sections are all present is left to the evidence gate, which is why this is expected to land short of VERIFIED_CURRENT.

truthBoundary: These are reviewed name mappings, not evidence. A section aliased to a module with no test still reports PARTIAL, and nothing here grants authority.
